sources.snippet: Clothes Segmentation using U2NET This repo contains training code, inference code and pre-trained model for Cloths Parsing from human portrait. Here clothes are parsed into 3 category: Upper body (red), Lower body (green) and Full body (yellow) This model works well with any background and almost all poses. For more samples visit samples.md
